title: Towards sustainable cultural-tourism integration in China’s ethnic regions – models, challenges, and policy strategies
core_idea: The study aims to advance understanding of integrating culture and tourism in China's ethnic regions by developing a 2×3 matrix of six integration models (concept-based: promotion and substitution; product-based; market-based) and using comparative case studies from Naxi, Miao, Zhuang, She, Qiang, and Tibetan regions to examine model applicability, integration pathways, and the institutional, resource, and market factors affecting sustainable integration.
tldr: Develops a 2×3 framework of six cultural-tourism integration models and uses comparative case studies across six Chinese ethnic regions to examine model applicability, integration pathways, contextual constraints, and potential policy strategies for sustainable integration.
